scientificAssessment.reasoning: Sun’s primary abstract supports cytosolic DNA sensing through cGAS/cGAMP/STING; Bakhoum supports mislocated genomic DNA in defined models, and Mukai supports intracellular ER/Golgi trafficking. The native does not specify DNA origin, which the owner caption correctly states. Host DNA need not change sequence to be misplaced. The image plus unchanged owner text retains that a PAMP is a feature and sensing does not establish infection, tumor-specific adaptive recognition, immunogenic cell death or benefit.
